checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Video is 5 seconds long and follows first 5 seconds of talk-one.mp4
must.why: Delivered clip is 10 s, not 5 s.
The face stays close to the original woman, with only slight changes. It does not resemble the dark-haired portrait woman.

must.item: Original kitchen, body motion and framing remain
must.why: Kitchen, framing and pose are preserved.
Audio is present, but I can't judge sync or content.

must.item: Face aligned during movement without flicker or doubles
must.why: Sampled frames show no doubled features, but I can't judge flicker across frames.

faults.what: Swap failed to transfer the portrait identity. The face is a slightly altered version of the original woman, with the same brown hair, so the user would see no clear swap.
Clip is 10 s instead of the required 5 s.
Face looks a bit smoothed and altered, and a necklace was added in the output.

summary: The clip keeps the kitchen and motion, but the face doesn't look like the portrait woman and the length is 10 s instead of 5 s.
